deliberation: Proxy delegation crosses the whole epistemic metabolism. A terminal-only fifteen-office gate preserves alternatives without imposing fifteen-office review on routine execution. The ten-office records remain valid predecessors but cannot stand in for fresh review of the terminal packet.
discharged_obligations: Compared ten-office, fifteen-office, advisory-Minder, preflight, and supermajority alternatives.
findings: Fifteen-office unanimity best satisfies the rule that no constitutional order is sufficient alone.
The expansion must be prospective and terminal-only.
amendments: Preserve rejected designs and reversal conditions in the exact terminal packet.
residual_uncertainty: The larger veto surface may delay disposition.
